categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes descriptor validation in src/script/descriptor.cpp, which governs key and descriptor management used by descriptor wallets.
categories.rationale: Fixes a Tapscript Miniscript validation bug where descriptors containing keys differing only by parity byte passed duplicate-key sanity checks. Because keys serialize without parity in Tapscript, this violates BIP-379 non-malleability invariants and 'allows third parties to malleate transactions by altering branch selectors without holding private keys' (PR description and commit 53439006c6).
